_doc: WILKE dating cabinet (#44, Wave E closer, built 2026-07-17-eve; roster #51 — the AD-CORPUS-BORN cabinet: our own 4 mirrored NYC ads seeded it). The 145+-year New York shop brand: Edwin Wilke 1872 -> the pipe-making SISTERS (Anna + Louisa) -> 1983 Nachwalter/Burns -> early-90s Vermont mail-order. THE POSTAL CLIFF: 'New York 17, N.Y.' = 1943-1963 (zone system) — already proven on our ad corpus. SOURCES: staging/pipedia/Wilke.json + Wilke_Briars.json (duplicates) + ads_archive/corpus wilke items (eBay ad scans) + Weber_Pipe_Co_.json (Weber supplied most Wilke pipes UNSTAINED).

history_anchors._doc: 1872: Edwin Wilke founds Wilke Tobacco, NYC. No sons -> daughters ANNA + LOUISA WILKE trained in pipemaking + blending; on his death 1930 they run it (1950: the only women pipe makers in the USA; customers incl. Herbert Hoover, Lord Halifax, John Steinbeck). Creed: 'unpainted pipes' — Macedonian briar only, no paint/varnish/plug/putty (our ad corpus confirms the wording + 'Established 1872' + 'pipes made to order from your own design'). Shop at 400 MADISON AVE at 48th for decades ('New York 17, N.Y.' on boxes/ads = zone era 1943-1963). Prices: to $100 by 1950, to $500 by 1970 (NY Magazine). 1970s: Wanamaker's (Philadelphia) satellite — Wilke pipes there made by STEVEN JOHNSON. 1983: brand bought by ELLIOTT NACHWALTER + CAROLE BURNS; Madison Ave store to the early 1990s -> Vermont, 'PIPEWORKS & WILKE' mail-order. Blending: Burns (Montpelier VT) to July 2017 -> John Brandt continues the blends. ⚠️ MAKER TRUTH (Weber article): most Wilke-stamped pipes were WEBER-made, supplied unstained ('Wilke Danish Bent' = a Weber model) — 'Wilke' dates the SHOP era, not a maker.

brand_marks.physical: Unstained natural finishes = the house creed. Nomenclature: WILKE + model/size; boxes + ads carry the Madison Ave address (+ postal zone in the 1943-63 window). Leather-accessory sales (pouches: suede/deerskin/peccary — our corpus ads).

line_years._notes: Model names (Squatty Bulldog, Prince of Wales, Tipped Billiard, Apple...) = shapes, not dated lines. 'catalog N' numbering seen in our ads — catalog-edition dating possible if catalogs surface.
